AU Small Finance Bank data leak sparks cyberattack concerns

AU Small Finance Bank has been affected by cyberattacks, leading to concerns among insurers about rising claim risks. Hackers have claimed responsibility for a data leak, with reports indicating that Salesforce, a cloud-based software provider used by the bank, is involved. Salesforce has denied the existence of a security flaw, while the extent of the data leak and its specific impact remain under scrutiny.
